transcript: You will find the right person, just not at the moment you once imagined, not when it is convenient, not when life feels perfectly arranged, not when confidence is at its highest. Sometimes they arrive while you are still healing, still unsure, still rebuilding what was quietly broken. They may meet a guarded version of you, a heart learning how to receive love without fear, without doubt, a version of you choosing to stay instead of running. Release the idea of the right time and the right person finds you. If this spoke to something in your heart, share it with someone who needs to hear it. Follow for more quiet truths like this.
